# Principles — index

*Generated by `pnpm xenso:principles` from the frontmatter of each entry.*
**Never edit this file by hand.** Edit the entry, then rebuild.

**13 in force** — 11 active, 2 provisional.

These are the rules **this** project learned. The Tao Te Ching project's twenty-seven apply here in full and are not repeated —
see [`../method.md`](../method.md) § 6 for the ones that fire hardest on this book.

*A principle fires on its **trigger**. Read that column first.*

| | When it fires | The rule | Applies to | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ✅ | you are rendering one member of a fixed set — the eight trigrams, the verdict graphs, a matched pair — and weighing its evidence on its own | **[A closed set is one decision, and the set's coherence is evidence](a-closed-set-is-one-decision.md)** | drafting · process | — |
| ✅ | you are writing a rule for this project that is stricter, looser, or otherwise unlike the one it inherits | **[A project that inherits a rulebook owes the record every place it differs from it](inheriting-means-saying-where-you-differ.md)** | process · sources | — |
| ✅ | you are about to mark a vendored file as proofread, verified, complete or authoritative | **[A provenance grade the importer cannot test is a claim, not a grade](a-grade-must-be-testable.md)** | sources · tooling | `xenso:import-iching` |
| ✅ | you are about to conclude that a source does not exist, is unavailable, or cannot be used | **[A search that found nothing is a finding, and belongs on the record with its date](record-the-search.md)** | sources · process | — |
| ✅ | a source offers something the same size and shape as the field you have to fill | **[A source shaped like the answer you owe is the most dangerous kind](a-source-shaped-like-your-answer.md)** | drafting · sources | — |
| ✅ | a term has two defensible senses and you are counting instances to choose between them, while the same text also sets that term in a pair, a sequence, or a run of parallel slots | **[A text that arranges its own terms has already ruled on them, and the arrangement outranks the lists](the-8-trigrams-are-arranged-in-4-pairs.md)** | drafting · glossary · sources | — |
| ✅ | you are about to rule out an English word, and the reason you can give is that a previous translator used it | **[A word is not spent because someone else used it, and agreement is evidence](convergence-is-evidence.md)** | drafting · sources · process | — |
| ✅ | you are about to start drafting at hexagram 1, or anywhere else the text happens to begin | **[In a formulaic text, frequency sets the order of decisions — the shared unit before the particular](frequency-sets-the-order.md)** | drafting · process | — |
| ✅ | a source is illegible, damaged or unreadable at some point, and you can tell what it says anyway | **[The model must never supply from memory what the source failed to deliver](never-supply-what-the-source-withheld.md)** | sources · tooling · drafting | — |
| ✅ | a parser cannot find a marker it expected, and you are choosing between dropping the block and keeping it unsegmented | **[When extraction degrades, lose the structure before the words — and name what was lost](lose-the-boundary-not-the-text.md)** | tooling · sources | `xenso:import-iching` |
| ✅ | a source carries both a position and a printed identifier, and you are about to key your data off the identifier | **[Where the label is the damaged thing, order assigns and the label checks](order-assigns-the-label-verifies.md)** | tooling · sources | `xenso:import-iching` |
| 🔶 | a tool reports how well it did, or you can explain why a result came out the way it did, and you are about to believe either one | **[An instrument's confidence in itself is not evidence, and neither is a plausible mechanism](an-instrument-is-not-a-witness-to-itself.md)** | tooling · sources | `xenso:ocr-consensus` |
| 🔶 | you are about to exclude a source because of a bias that every other available source also has | **[Where every available witness shares a bias, measure across them — excluding them buys blindness, not purity](no-neutral-witness.md)** | sources · drafting · process | — |
